title: EndpointsCreateResult
description: Result of the endpoints.create JSON-RPC method: the stored endpoint (design §4.5.4, ADR-0030). The API key sent in the params is minted into the vault and never appears here — the result carries the credential's row handle, or null when the endpoint was created without a key. The shape is the single declaration in endpoints.list.schema.json, referenced cross-file.
